account.noNfts: No NFTs in the scanned objects.
account.objectsTruncated: Some objects beyond the scanned range are omitted.

receipt.netFeeExplanation: The network fee shown above includes the storage rebate. If it is negative, the rebate exceeds the computation and storage charges.
receipt.estimatedNetFeeExplanation: The estimated network fee shown above includes the storage rebate. If it is negative, the rebate exceeds the estimated computation and storage charges.
receipt.gasLimitExplanation: The gas budget limits network fee spending. It is not an estimate of the amount charged.
receipt.graphTip: A diagram of this transaction's programmable transaction block (PTB), derived from public on-chain data. It is a diagnostic view only, not transaction input, signing, or a safety verdict.
receipt.graphReviewTip: A diagram of the transaction prepared for this review and simulation. It shows what is being reviewed, not an actual result, permission to sign, or a guarantee of safety.
receipt.graphFailed: The transaction graph could not be rendered

chart.boundaryUsdc: Prices are in USDC, not USD; dollar parity is not guaranteed.

common.walletStatusRecovery: Ask in chat to open Settings, then use Troubleshooting to restart the connection service. This does not confirm removal of a connection in your wallet app.
